title: "TWAS Weight Computation Summary"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
params:
  cell_types: null
  weights_dir: null
  pos_file: null
  coord_file: null
  weights_log: null
  bmark_dir: null

```{r set_up, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(gt)
library(cowplot)

source(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "twas_functions.R"))

# Set variables from params
# Path params are patterns containing {cell_type}, as in the config
cell_types <- strsplit(params$cell_types, ",")[[1]]
models <- strsplit(params$models, ",")[[1]]
cis_window <- as.numeric(params$cis_window)
hsq_p <- as.numeric(params$hsq_p)
crossval <- as.numeric(params$crossval)

ct_path <- function(pattern, ct) str_replace_all(pattern, fixed("{cell_type}"), ct)

# Plot height scales with the number of cell types
fig_h <- max(4, 0.3 * length(cell_types))

show_tbl <- function(tbl, ...) {
  kable(tbl, format = "html", ...) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
}
```

```{r load_data}
## Per-gene outcome for every gene in the coordinate file  ---------------------------
gene_status <- map_dfr(cell_types, function(ct) {

  coord_genes <- read_tsv(ct_path(params$coord_file, ct), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    pull(gene_id)

  log_file <- ct_path(params$weights_log, ct)
  log_status <- if (file.exists(log_file)) {
    classify_weights_log(readLines(log_file)) |>
      # A gene listed twice in the coordinate file is run twice; the last run wins
      group_by(gene) |>
      slice_tail(n = 1) |>
      ungroup()
  } else {
    tibble(gene = character(), log_status = character())
  }

  pos_genes <- read_tsv(ct_path(params$pos_file, ct), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    pull(ID)

  tibble(cell_type = ct, gene = coord_genes) |>
    add_count(gene, name = "n_coord_rows") |>
    distinct(cell_type, gene, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    left_join(log_status, by = "gene") |>
    mutate(status = case_when(
      gene %in% pos_genes                ~ "weights",
      log_status == "hsq_skip"           ~ "hsq_skip",
      log_status == "gcta_failed"        ~ "gcta_failed",
      log_status == "no_fusion_output"   ~ "no_cis_snps",
      log_status == "fusion_ran"         ~ "other_failure",
      is.na(log_status)                  ~ "not_in_log"
    ))
})

## Weight file summaries for genes in the .pos files  --------------------------------
wgt_tbl <- map_dfr(cell_types, function(ct) {
  pos <- read_tsv(ct_path(params$pos_file, ct), show_col_types = FALSE)
  file.path(ct_path(params$weights_dir, ct), pos$WGT) |>
    map_dfr(read_fusion_wgt, models = models) |>
    mutate(cell_type = ct, .before = 1)
})

ct_levels <- rev(cell_types)  # first cell type at the top of horizontal plots
```

***

## TWAS weight computation pipeline steps {.tabset}

***

We used [FUSION](http://gusevlab.org/projects/fusion/) to compute gene expression
prediction weights for each cell type. The weights are used by cTWAS (pipeline
12CTWAS). FUSION is described in
[Gusev et al. 2016 (DOI:10.1038/ng.3506)](https://www.nature.com/articles/ng.3506).

**Pipeline rules**

1. `get_gemma`: download the GEMMA 0.98.5 binary. GEMMA is only used by FUSION's
   `bslmm` and `blup` models; it is kept so those models can be added.
2. `prep_exp_data`: transpose the tensorQTL expression bed to PLINK phenotype format,
   and get gene coordinates from Ensembl BioMart.
3. `convert_vcf`: convert the filtered genotype VCF to PLINK binary format
   (bed/bim/fam).
4. `get_ldref_snplist`: list the SNP IDs in the 1000G EUR hg38 LD reference.
5. `prepare_covar`: transpose the tensorQTL covariate file to PLINK covariate format.
6. `compute_weights`: for each gene, extract the cis SNPs (gene start/end ± the cis
   window, LD reference SNPs only) and run `FUSION.compute_weights.R`. Genes with no
   cis SNPs, non-significant heritability or a FUSION failure get an empty
   placeholder `.wgt.RDat` file.
7. `make_pos_file`: list the genes with weights in a FUSION `.pos` file. 12CTWAS
   `copy_fusion_weights` uses it to copy only genuine weights for cTWAS.
8. `twas_weights_report`: this report.

**Settings**

```{r settings}
tibble(
  Setting = c("Cis window", "Heritability p-value threshold (<code>hsq_p</code>)",
              "Cross-validation folds (<code>crossval</code>)",
              "Models (<code>models</code>)", "Model used by cTWAS"),
  Value = c(paste0("±", format(cis_window / 1000, big.mark = ","), " kb"),
            as.character(hsq_p), as.character(crossval),
            paste(models, collapse = ", "), "lasso")
) |>
  show_tbl(escape = FALSE)
```

***

### Gene funnel

***

Outcome for every gene in each cell type's gene coordinate file. "No cis SNPs" is
inferred: FUSION only runs when plink2 finds cis SNPs, so a gene with no FUSION
output in the log is counted here. FUSION skips a gene when its cis-heritability is
negative or its LRT p-value is above `r hsq_p`.

```{r funnel}
n_tot_tbl <- wgt_tbl |>
  group_by(cell_type) |>
  summarise(N = if (min(n_tot) == max(n_tot)) as.character(min(n_tot))
                else paste0(min(n_tot), "–", max(n_tot)))

funnel <- gene_status |>
  count(cell_type, status) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

# Make sure every outcome column exists, even if no gene has it
for (col in c("no_cis_snps", "hsq_skip", "gcta_failed", "other_failure", "weights",
              "not_in_log")) {
  if (!col %in% colnames(funnel)) funnel[[col]] <- 0L
}

nonzero_lasso <- wgt_tbl |>
  group_by(cell_type) |>
  summarise(lasso = sum(n_snps_lasso > 0, na.rm = TRUE))

funnel <- funnel |>
  left_join(n_tot_tbl, by = "cell_type") |>
  left_join(nonzero_lasso, by = "cell_type") |>
  mutate(genes = no_cis_snps + hsq_skip + gcta_failed + other_failure + weights + not_in_log,
         lasso = replace_na(lasso, 0L),
         pct_lasso = round(100 * lasso / genes, 1),
         cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = cell_types)) |>
  arrange(cell_type) |>
  select(cell_type, N, genes, no_cis_snps, hsq_skip, gcta_failed, other_failure,
         not_in_log, weights, lasso, pct_lasso)

funnel_names <- c("Cell type", "N", "Genes", "No cis SNPs", "h² not sig.",
                  "GCTA failed", "Other failure", "Not in log", "With weights",
                  "Non-zero lasso", "% genes with lasso")

# Only show 'Not in log' if any gene is affected
if (all(funnel$not_in_log == 0)) {
  funnel_names <- funnel_names[-8]
  funnel <- select(funnel, -not_in_log)
}

show_tbl(funnel, col.names = funnel_names, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

```{r funnel_notes, results = "asis"}
dup_genes <- gene_status |>
  filter(n_coord_rows > 1) |>
  count(cell_type, name = "n_dup")

if (nrow(dup_genes) > 0) {
  cat("\n**Note:** some genes appear more than once in the gene coordinate file and were",
      "run more than once (the last run is kept):",
      paste0(paste0(dup_genes$cell_type, " (", dup_genes$n_dup, ")", collapse = ", "), ".\n"))
}

if (any(gene_status$status == "other_failure")) {
  cat("\n**Note:** 'Other failure' means FUSION wrote output for the gene but neither",
      "produced weights nor gave a recognised skip message. Check the",
      "`compute_weights` log for these genes.\n")
}
```

***

### Heritability

***

Cis-heritability (h²) estimated by FUSION (GCTA REML) for genes with weights. These
genes all passed the heritability filter (p < `r hsq_p`), so the distribution is
shifted upwards compared with all expressed genes.

```{r hsq_plot, fig.height = fig_h, fig.width = 8}
wgt_tbl |>
  mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = ct_levels)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = hsq, y = cell_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, fill = "#8DA0CB") +
  labs(x = "Cis-heritability (h²)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r hsq_table}
wgt_tbl |>
  group_by(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = cell_types)) |>
  summarise(genes = n(),
            median_hsq = round(median(hsq), 3),
            q1 = round(quantile(hsq, 0.25), 3),
            q3 = round(quantile(hsq, 0.75), 3),
            median_se = round(median(hsq_se), 3)) |>
  show_tbl(col.names = c("Cell type", "Genes", "Median h²", "Q1", "Q3",
                         "Median SE"),
           format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

***

### Prediction performance

***

Cross-validated prediction accuracy from FUSION's `r crossval`-fold cross-validation:
adjusted R² between predicted and observed expression in held-out samples (can be
slightly negative). cTWAS uses the lasso model and does not filter genes on
prediction accuracy, so the last column shows how many lasso models would pass a
conventional CV p < 0.05. The best model is the one with the smallest CV p-value.

```{r r2_plot, fig.height = fig_h, fig.width = 8}
wgt_tbl |>
  filter(!is.na(rsq_lasso)) |>
  mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = ct_levels)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rsq_lasso, y = cell_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, fill = "#66C2A5") +
  labs(x = "Lasso cross-validated R²", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r r2_table}
r2_tbl <- wgt_tbl |>
  group_by(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = cell_types)) |>
  summarise(
    across(all_of(paste0("rsq_", models)), ~ round(median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 3)),
    pct_lasso_best = round(100 * mean(best_model == "lasso", na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    pct_lasso_p05 = round(100 * mean(pval_lasso < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  )

show_tbl(r2_tbl,
         col.names = c("Cell type", paste0("Median R² (", models, ")"),
                       "% lasso best", "% lasso CV p < 0.05"))
```

***

### Lasso model size

***

Number of SNPs with non-zero lasso weights, for genes with a non-zero lasso model.

```{r size_table}
wgt_tbl |>
  filter(n_snps_lasso > 0) |>
  group_by(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = cell_types)) |>
  summarise(genes = n(),
            median_snps = median(n_snps_lasso),
            mean_snps = round(mean(n_snps_lasso), 1),
            max_snps = max(n_snps_lasso),
            pct_single = round(100 * mean(n_snps_lasso == 1), 1),
            median_cis = median(n_snps_cis)) |>
  show_tbl(col.names = c("Cell type", "Genes", "Median SNPs", "Mean SNPs", "Max SNPs",
                         "% single-SNP", "Median cis SNPs tested"),
           format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

***

### Benchmarking {.tabset}

***

#### Table

```{r bmark_load}
rule_names <- c("get_gemma", "prep_exp_data", "convert_vcf", "get_ldref_snplist",
                "prepare_covar", "compute_weights", "make_pos_file", "twas_weights_report")

bmark_files <- list.files(params$bmark_dir, pattern = "^11twas\\..*\\.benchmark\\.txt$")

# File names are 11twas.<rule>[_<cell_type>].benchmark.txt; match the known rule
# names so rule names containing '_' are kept whole
benchmarks <- tibble(file = bmark_files) |>
  mutate(stem = str_remove_all(file, "^11twas\\.|\\.benchmark\\.txt$"),
         rule = map_chr(stem, function(s) {
           hit <- rule_names[s == rule_names | str_starts(s, paste0(rule_names, "_"))]
           if (length(hit) == 0) NA_character_ else hit[1]
         }),
         cell_type = if_else(stem == rule, NA_character_,
                             str_remove(stem, paste0("^", rule, "_"))))

unmatched <- filter(benchmarks, is.na(rule))$file

benchmarks <- benchmarks |>
  filter(!is.na(rule), is.na(cell_type) | cell_type %in% cell_types) |>
  mutate(data = map(file, function(f) {
    read_tsv(file.path(params$bmark_dir, f), show_col_types = FALSE,
             col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) |>
      transmute(runtime_sec = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(s)),
                max_rss = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(max_rss)))
  })) |>
  unnest(data)

# Summarise by rule
summary <- benchmarks |>
  group_by(rule = factor(rule, levels = rule_names)) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_runtime_min = mean(runtime_sec, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
    sd_runtime_min = sd(runtime_sec, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
    mean_ram_gb = mean(max_rss, na.rm = TRUE) / 1024,
    sd_ram_gb = sd(max_rss, na.rm = TRUE) / 1024,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    sd_runtime_min = if_else(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min),
    sd_ram_gb = if_else(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb),
    mean_ram_gb = if_else(is.nan(mean_ram_gb), NA_real_, mean_ram_gb),  # no RAM recorded
    rule = as.character(rule)
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3)))

# Table
summary |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Benchmarking",
    subtitle = "Means and SD across jobs"
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    rule = "Rule",
    n = "N",
    mean_runtime_min = "Mean Runtime (min)",
    sd_runtime_min = "SD Runtime (min)",
    mean_ram_gb = "Mean RAM (GB)",
    sd_ram_gb = "SD RAM (GB)"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(mean_runtime_min, sd_runtime_min, mean_ram_gb, sd_ram_gb),
    decimals = 2
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14),
    table.border.top.style = "none",
    table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.color = "black",
    heading.align = "center"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  )
```

```{r bmark_notes, results = "asis"}
if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
  cat("\n**Note:** benchmark files not matching a current rule name (not shown):",
      paste0("`", unmatched, "`", collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

***

#### Plot

***

```{r runtime_plt, fig.dim = c(10, 5)}
runtime_plt <- ggplot(summary, aes(x = reorder(rule, mean_runtime_min),
                                   y = mean_runtime_min)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_runtime_min - sd_runtime_min,
                    ymax = mean_runtime_min + sd_runtime_min),
                width = 0.3, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Rule", y = "Runtime (minutes)",
       title = "Mean runtime per rule") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

mem_plt <- ggplot(summary, aes(x = reorder(rule, mean_ram_gb),
                               y = mean_ram_gb)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_ram_gb - sd_ram_gb,
                    ymax = mean_ram_gb + sd_ram_gb),
                width = 0.3, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Rule", y = "RAM (GB)",
       title = "Mean RAM usage per rule") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

plot_grid(runtime_plt, mem_plt)
```
